_note: DM · 11th grade · military aviation · PHYSICS, not algebra. Every level is one core law, named in full on the card, restated in the hints and restated again in the walkthrough — so he meets the same fundamentals on every single problem rather than once. The board already forces a typed response per line, which is the engagement: he cannot watch, he has to answer.
name: Smart Flight Physics
tagline: Physics, but everything is on fire and moving fast. Pick your sortie. ✈️

levels.name: Throttle Up
levels.cheer: Your instructor's coffee is sitting in the cup holder. You firewall the throttle: 90,000 N of thrust on a 15,000 kg jet. The coffee is now on the ceiling. He is not saying anything, which is worse. ☕
levels.question: THE LAW: Force = mass × acceleration. What acceleration did that coffee experience?
hints: THE LAW: F = ma. You have F and m. Solve for a.
15000x = 90000. x is multiplied by 15000, so divide BOTH sides by 15000.
90000 ÷ 15000 = 6. So a = 6 m/s². Say it back: force equals mass times acceleration.

walkthrough.title: The law, every time
walkthrough.body: Newton's Second Law: Force = mass × acceleration. Write it before you write anything else.

walkthrough.title: Put the numbers in
walkthrough.body: F is 90,000 N. m is 15,000 kg. The unknown is a.

walkthrough.title: Undo the multiplication
walkthrough.body: Divide BOTH sides by 15,000. Coffee accelerated at 6 m/s².

levels.name: Rotate
levels.cheer: You need 54 m/s to get the nose off the runway. You're starting from a dead stop and accelerating at 6 m/s². The runway does not go on forever. This is now a timing question. 🛫
levels.question: THE LAW: final speed = starting speed + (acceleration × time). Starting speed is zero. How long until you rotate?
hints: THE LAW: v = u + at. You start from rest, so u = 0 and it becomes v = at.
54 ÷ 6 = 9 seconds. Say it back: final speed equals starting speed plus acceleration times time.

walkthrough.title: The law, every time
walkthrough.body: v = u + at. Final speed equals starting speed plus acceleration multiplied by time.

walkthrough.title: Kill the zero
walkthrough.body: You started from rest, so u = 0. That leaves v = at.

walkthrough.title: Solve for time
walkthrough.body: Divide BOTH sides by 6. Nine seconds to rotate.

levels.name: Ground Crew
levels.cheer: You lost a bet, so you're on the tow bar. You dragged the aircraft 800 m across the apron and did 480,000 J of work. Your back has opinions. The bet was about physics. 🛩️
levels.question: THE LAW: Work = force × distance. What force were you pulling with?
hints: THE LAW: W = Fd. Work equals force times distance.
480000 ÷ 800 = 600 N. Say it back: work equals force times distance.

walkthrough.title: The law, every time
walkthrough.body: Work = force × distance. Work is measured in joules, force in newtons, distance in metres.

walkthrough.title: Put the numbers in
walkthrough.body: W is 480,000 J. d is 800 m. The unknown is F.

walkthrough.title: Solve for force
walkthrough.body: Divide BOTH sides by 800. You were pulling with 600 N.

levels.name: Momentum Check
levels.cheer: Ground radar clocked your momentum at 240,000 kg·m/s in a 12,000 kg trainer. Somebody in the tower has already picked up a phone. You should probably know how fast you were going before they ask. 📡
levels.question: THE LAW: momentum = mass × velocity. How fast were you actually going?
hints: THE LAW: p = mv. Momentum equals mass times velocity.
240000 ÷ 12000 = 20 m/s. Say it back: momentum equals mass times velocity.

walkthrough.title: The law, every time
walkthrough.body: Momentum = mass × velocity. Heavy and slow can carry the same momentum as light and fast.

walkthrough.title: Put the numbers in
walkthrough.body: p is 240,000 kg·m/s. m is 12,000 kg. The unknown is v.

walkthrough.title: Solve for velocity
walkthrough.body: Divide BOTH sides by 12,000. Twenty metres per second.

levels.name: Wheels Up
levels.tagline: NET FORCE · F(net) = ma  ·  the final boss 🏆
levels.cheer: Engines: 90,000 N of thrust. Air: 30,000 N of drag, taking its cut whether you like it or not. Aircraft: 12,000 kg. Only the force that's LEFT OVER accelerates you — this is the one everybody gets wrong. ✈️
levels.question: THE LAW: thrust − drag = mass × acceleration. What's your actual acceleration?
hints: THE LAW: only NET force accelerates anything. Thrust − drag = ma.
Deal with drag first: subtract 30000 from BOTH sides → 12000x = 60000.
Now divide BOTH sides by 12000. 60000 ÷ 12000 = 5 m/s². Say it back: net force equals mass times acceleration.

walkthrough.title: The law, every time
walkthrough.body: Net force = mass × acceleration. NET means after everything pulling the other way has taken its share.

walkthrough.title: Pay the drag
walkthrough.body: Drag takes 30,000 N off the top. Subtract it from BOTH sides.

walkthrough.title: Solve for acceleration
walkthrough.body: Divide BOTH sides by 12,000. Five metres per second squared — not the 7.5 you'd have got by ignoring drag.
